summary: Anthropic-affiliated researchers propose a red-teaming framework for evaluating training-based interventions against diffuse AI control threats (e.g., sandbagging) on hard-to-grade 'fuzzy' tasks like generating ML research proposals.

practices.reason: The paper describes a red-teaming/adversarial evaluation framework for testing whether training interventions catch subversive behavior in scheming models, which safety teams could adapt but is not turnkey.
practices.quote: We propose a red-teaming framework to evaluate training interventions against threats from scheming AIs, such as sandbagging on difficult-to-grade tasks.
